messages.subject: Senior ESG & Sustainability Executive | Mining, Regulation & Energy Transition
messages.body:
Dear Sustii Team,

Your specialist focus on senior sustainability and ESG leadership, particularly where regulation, energy transition and operational reality intersect, makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit combines ESG and social performance with government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, climate action, strategic partnerships and executive communications in a complex mining environment.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across ESG and Sustainability, External Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Responsible Business and Energy Transition. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific and the Americas.

My executive CV is attached for review and I would welcome consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
